messages.content: The tests in this project fail. Find out why and fix it.

The bug is in the unit table: `'m'` is mapped to `time.Second` instead of `time.Minute`. That makes "45m" parse as 45 seconds, and "1h30m" as 1h0m30s. I'll fix that line.

message.content:
The tests were failing because of one wrong line in `duration.go`. The unit table mapped `'m'` to `time.Second`, so minutes were parsed as seconds. "45m" came out as 45 seconds, and "1h30m" came out as 1h0m30s.

I changed that entry to `time.Minute`. All tests now pass.
